title: Kulbergs to hold coalition talks with National Alliance, New Unity
summary_full: Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List”), to whom the President has also entrusted the task of forming the next government, will begin talks next week with potential coalition partners on the formation of the new government. On Wednesday, 28 October, the United List plans to meet with its current coalition partners, the National Alliance and New Unity.
